newsitem.title: USA: Coconino SMA unit inks distribution pact.
newsitem.headline: Coconino SMA unit inks distribution pact.

text.p: Coconino SMA Inc said Tuesday that its wholly owned subsidiary, Ad-HaTTeRs Inc, has signed an exclusive distribution arrangement with SUNGHO U.S.A. for distribution of products to South Korea. SUNGHO U.S.A. is an affiliate of SUNHO, a South Korean distributor.
Ad-HaTTeRs said it confident that SUNHO is capable of moving more than 10,000 units per month once it is fully established. Ad-HaTTeRs makes a line of novelty air fresheners for cars.
Coconino is a diversified marketing company which also sells pewter sculptures and Native American jewelry, and owns and operates oil and gas properties.
